description: This Java class implements the EmailConfigurationReadPlatformService interface for reading email configuration data from the database within the Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve all email configurations and fetch a specific configuration by name, mapping database results to EmailConfigurationData objects.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationRowMapper
classes.description: Inner static class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to EmailConfigurationData objects, with predefined schema SQL string.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all email configuration entries from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single email configuration by its name; throws exception if not found.
